beats.note: A national referendum on switching from left-hand to right-hand traffic failed by a landslide; only 15.5% voted in favour.
The Riksdag approved the change in 1963 under pressure from the Council of Europe and the Nordic Council; overriding the 1955 vote.

beats.name: Dagen H
beats.role: 3 September, 5:00 a.m. A loudspeaker announcement; 'Nu är det dags att byta!' ('Now is the time to change!'); and the whole country moved to the right side of the road at once.

beats.note: Most were swapped in the 24 hours before the switch. The whole operation cost 628 million kronor.

beats.text: The crash rate didn't spike. It fell.

beats.line: Norway and Finland already drove on the right. Sweden was the odd one out.
